description: List sandboxes, newest first: id, state, template, shape, labels, and when each is deleted. Lists only the sandboxes this server made on this machine (the ones carrying this install's prized-mcp-scope label), the only ones its tools use, unless the person set PRIZED_MCP_ALL_SANDBOXES=1, which lists and opens every sandbox in the workspace.

labels.description: Only sandboxes carrying every one of these labels. prized-mcp-scope cannot be passed: this server sets it.

state.description: Only sandboxes in this state, such as running or paused.

name: list_sandboxes

autoDeleteMinutes.description: Minutes after it pauses before it is deleted; 0 or null: kept until deleted.

autoPauseMinutes.description: Idle minutes before it pauses itself; 0 or null: never.

errorReason.description: Why it is in the error state, when it is.

expiresAt.description: When it is deleted (ISO 8601), or null.

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Minutes of running before it is deleted.

state.description: starting, running, pausing, paused, resizing, deleting or error.

template.description: The template it was made from, such as prized-base-v1.

title: List sandboxes
